name: unify-inapp-terminal-sandbox
title: Unify in-app terminals with sandbox root and JDK command support
description: Unify the editor run terminal, home built-in terminal and quick-tools local terminal into one sandboxed terminal implementation. Sandbox root is parameterized: editor entry roots at the current project; app/home entry roots at the app private data directory so every project file is reachable. Implement portable in-sandbox file commands, route java/javac through the existing native JDK bridge (same path as Run), and report honest unsupported messages for unavailable system tools. Keep behavior consistent on OHOS and desktop.
creator: lichengyu
